ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Discovering Systems of the Carribbean Islands. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agricultural Economics or Animal Sciences or Agribusiness, Farm & Financial or Consumer and Textile Marketing or Intl, Resource, Consumer Econ or Ornamental Horticulture or Forestry or Human Devel & Family Ecology or Technical Systems Management or Agr Engineering & Agr Science or Crop Sciences or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Human Development & Family St or Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci or Horticulture or Nondegree or Economics or Human Resources & Family Std or Agr & Consumer Economics or Agronomy or Plant Pathology or Agricultural Education or Human & Community Development or Food Science or Natural Res & Env Sciences or Nutritional Sciences or Latin American Studies or Biology or Plant Biology or General Curriculum or Integrative Biology major(s).
